name: pumpkin-cms-workspace
description: Downstream Pumpkin CMS integration workspace for deterministic starter, model, and block-view builds.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace pumpkin-ts-models && npm run build --workspace pumpkin-block-views
scripts.test:starter:contracts: npm run test:preview-fixtures --workspace pumpkin-starter-app && npm run test:host-tenant-runtime --workspace pumpkin-starter-app
scripts.ci:root: npm run workspace:inventory && npm run test:block-contracts && npm run test:static-publication && npm run test:publication-product && npm run test:onboarding:dry-run && npm run build:packages && npm run type-check:starter && npm run test:starter:contracts
